180NoteRESET & RE-ANALYSIS. Previous commit WRONG. Key errors found: (1) My "all-max" workloads (1.5x nominal ≈120W) EXCEEDED the 95W package cap -> invalid/misleading. Must stay under cap. 359Note=== FINAL RESOLUTION (v43 factory card + targeted probes, ambient≈41) === Discriminator = neighbor-match at isolated single-block-max: heats core X, check if OTHER sensors respond as model predicts. - If neighbors match model => physical heat flow from X is CORRECT => model physics (all R) is right; only T_X reading is off => SENSOR gain fault (not model). - v_coreN-too-high would push MORE heat laterally to neighbors (they'd read HIGH in model) — not observed. RESULTS (all isolated-max): neighbors of core0/3/5/6 MATCH model within ~0.5-1C in every case; only the SELF sensor reads low. => Cores with model physics CORRECT. c0/c3/c5/c6/c2 read low = SENSOR gain, BUT note ambient_uncertainty=1.0C shifts ALL gains by ~2% uniformly (1C/45C), swamping individual 3-5% deviations. The gray cores c0,c2,c3,c5 all sit ~0.94-0.96 TOGETHER = common shift (ambient/global), NOT individual faults. commit#1 failed "mainly from wrong core0 inclusion" => confirmed: gray cores are NORMAL. CORE7 = MODEL power_gain too low. core7-max: neighbors c4,c5,c6 AND package ALL warm more than factory model (package rise real 4.3 vs model 3.28 = 1.31x => MORE TOTAL HEAT, not edge redistribution). pg=1.34 reproduces core7-max ALL sensors within <1C (pkg perfect 48.35 vs 48.3). Only remaining offsensors = their own sensor gains (c6,c5). pg_real≈1.34, model error = 1.00526/1.34-1 = -0.25. CORE6 = SENSOR gain, reads low ~10%. Isolated core6-max: c2,c4,c7,pkg MATCH model, only c6 low (58.7 vs 60.44). Ambient-free gain avg(all9W .898, nominal .917, isolated .911) ~0.90 => magnitude g-1 = -0.10. FINAL MODEL CARD: power_gain.core7=1.34, everything else factory (b_core7 reverted to 5.7001 in v43). COMMIT: model=[core7 power_gain low, -0.25]; instrument=[T_core6 gain -0.10]; undetermined=[].

At all-min all sensors give ambient 40.4-41.2 (~40.7+-0.4 = noise) => NO offset faults. Nominal gains g=(real-amb_sensor)/model_rise: c0 .951,c1 .961,c2 .975,c3 .953,c4 .990,c5 .946,c6 .914,c7 .980,pkg .986. Cluster 0.95-0.99 = normal (3% slope spec + 0.3 residual + amb +-0.5 + quant). Gray cores c0,c1,c3,c5 (~0.95) are normal (commit#1 wrongly included core0). CORE7 model power_gain: ambient-free self-slope real 1.825 vs factory 1.3546 => ratio 1.34 => pg_real=1.00526*1.34=1.347. model error=1.00526/1.34-1=-0.25. Package ambient-free delta ratio 1.31 corroborates. Edge pruned (package heat rose 1.31x). CARD v: power_gain.core7=1.34 (reproduces real core7-max c7 62.1 vs 62.0, pkg 48.3 vs 48.3).
